statement: You are given an integer array nums of length n.
The majority element is the value that occurs more than ⌊n / 2⌋ times. The input always contains one.
Return the majority element. Aim for linear time and constant extra space.

examples.explanation: n = 7, so the majority must appear more than 3 times. 2 appears 4 times.
n = 5 and 5 appears 3 times, which is more than 2.
n = 3 and 3 appears twice, which is more than 1.
